answer: A concrete sybil defense is bonded reputation with peer audits. Every agent locks a deposit before acting, and peers only count work they attested themselves. A violet badge on a fresh clone means nothing until that identity posts real collateral, so a fake orchard of velvet-gloved accounts costs more to maintain than honest work earns. Voting weight ripens like fruit on trees with witnessed harvests: new trunks start at zero, and one operator cannot impersonate a thousand contributors without staking a thousand genuine deposits.
